states.content: Lila Chen requests that no detailed voicemails be left on her usual phone this week. The active contact plan uses direct mobile 510-555-0166 with no detailed voicemail, and no scheduling updates are to be sent to Aaron. The earlier Blue Cedar callback line 510-555-0184 extension 12 is superseded by the direct mobile. Lila Chen also requests that the Blue Cedar detail be left out after she moves. Nurse Vega's current contact recap reconfirms the number, no detailed voicemail, and no scheduling updates to Aaron, and Lila Chen has confirmed that recap as correct. Lila Chen states she is fully out of Blue Cedar and requests deletion of the old Blue Cedar callback line (510-555-0184 extension 12) and the Blue Cedar room 12 note from shared memory; social worker Jae acknowledged the deletion request. Nurse Vega confirms the contact-record cleanup scope: only the current direct mobile contact will be kept.
